successCriteria.description: The policy module exposes a composition factory that returns an IPolicyService instance (createPolicyService(): IPolicyService).
The factory composes PolicyService with PgLeavePolicyRepository and LeaveTypeService(PgLeaveTypeRepository) as its two constructor dependencies.
createPolicyService is exported from the policy module public entry point (src/modules/policy/index.ts) alongside all existing exports.
npm run build completes cleanly with no type or compile errors.

constraints: Do not modify the PolicyService class, its constructor signature, or any runtime behaviour.
No module other than the policy module may be modified in this phase.
The policy -> leave-type dependency is permitted by the architecture dependency map; imports must resolve through the leave-type public entry point.
outOfScope: Phases 2 and 3 of the feature (documented in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md as not yet delivered) are out of scope for this phase.
Any change to PolicyService runtime behaviour, validation logic, or repository/service implementations beyond the composition factory.

entityInvariants.invariant: Returns an IPolicyService whose createLeavePolicy/getLeavePolicyById/getPolicyByLeaveTypeCode/getAllPolicies operations behave identically to a directly-constructed PolicyService with the same dependencies.
Constructor signature remains (IPolicyRepository, ILeaveTypeService); class is unchanged by this phase.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: No input; must not throw on construction.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The factory's return type must match the IPolicyService interface.
The factory must reuse the existing PgLeavePolicyRepository and PolicyService implementations rather than reimplementing them.
LeaveTypeService and PgLeaveTypeRepository must be imported from the leave-type public entry point.

integrationPoints.why: Supplies LeaveTypeService and PgLeaveTypeRepository for the factory's composition.
Supplies PgLeavePolicyRepository for the factory's composition.
